name: detent-recover-teaser
description: Detent Recover — The Leaky Bucket teaser film pipeline

scripts.audio: npm run vo && npm run music && npm run sfx && npm run scan
scripts.render:preview: npm run scan && npm run qc && remotion render src/index.ts Teaser-16x9 out/teaser-16x9-1080p.mp4 --scale=0.5
scripts.render:16x9: npm run scan && npm run qc && remotion render src/index.ts Teaser-16x9 out/teaser-16x9-4k.mp4 && scripts/master-audio.sh out/teaser-16x9-4k.mp4
scripts.render:16x9-captioned: remotion render src/index.ts Teaser-16x9-Captioned out/teaser-16x9-captioned-4k.mp4 && scripts/master-audio.sh out/teaser-16x9-captioned-4k.mp4
scripts.render:1x1: remotion render src/index.ts Teaser-1x1 out/teaser-1x1.mp4 --scale=0.5 && scripts/master-audio.sh out/teaser-1x1.mp4
scripts.render:9x16: remotion render src/index.ts Teaser-9x16 out/teaser-9x16.mp4 --scale=0.5 && scripts/master-audio.sh out/teaser-9x16.mp4
